notes: M20 Barkhide Troll, printed: '{1}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: ...'. Both parts of the cost are needed: a Troll with its counter and no mana is refused (the {1}), a Troll with mana and no +1/+1 counter is refused (the removal), and the Troll with both pays them: the counter and the one colourless are gone.
